title: The city overhaul (layout 3)
status: Building on branch city/overhaul; ships only on Tyler's OK
summary: Fill the dead north: the docks and the harbour along the north edge (quay, piers, cranes, container yard, the Pier 9 warehouse, a boardable freighter; the water drowns), the Panopticon precinct in the north-west (front house, a three-floor ring cellblock round a guard tower, the yard), Gate Lane from the Gate to the precinct, Quay Road, north sewer branches, cut corners and one bank wall in every landmark, a chute off Needleworks' upper floors, and Ironclad moved into the fights. Every district gets a job in every assignment. Plan: docs/city-overhaul.md.
goals: Rats go north: the docks and the precinct become places people play, not the empty quarter of the map.
More banking shots: angled and curved walls (cut corners, landmark bank walls, the ring cellblock, cell bars) give cheese something to glance off.
The west comes alive: the precinct and Gate Lane bring the fight to the west side.
The case never sits stuck upstairs in Needleworks: the chute brings rats and a loose case down to the street.
Ironclad is worth taking: sites moved to where the fights are (the precinct armoury, beside the Records forecourt).

predictions.says: The north third's share of human time rises (the numerator of Use; layout 2 held about a quarter of the map with almost no play).
A bigger share of human hits come off a wall first.
The west third's share of all deaths rises: the fight reaches the precinct and Gate Lane.

Less of the case's life happens on Needleworks' upper floors: the share of case takes, drops and steals on floors 8 and 16 falls (the public counts' stand-in for the case's time upstairs; the archive's case facts give the exact time).
Ironclad is claimed more often per rat-hour.
